description: Land Title Settlement Department - Polwatta, Maharagama D/S Division, Colombo District  (24/0710)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, including declarations of title determination for specific land parcels, ownership details, and land registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels with owner information, parcel numbers, extents, and encumbrances, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
